info.name: Al-Hassam Medical Center - Complete API Test Suite
info.description: Comprehensive production API test suite for Al-Hassam Medical Center & SmartClinic Healthcare SaaS (Sanghar, Sindh). Fully automated verification covering all 14 Express subsystems: Multi-tenant Onboarding, 4-tier RBAC authentication (Admin, Doctor, Receptionist, Pharmacist), Patient Registry, 7 Specialist Doctor Consultations, Appointment Scheduling, FEFO Pharmacy POS, Billing & Invoicing, Google Gemini AI Co-Pilot with Trilingual Slips (English, Roman Urdu, Sindhi), WebRTC Telemedicine, and Facility Analytics.
